comparison.objective: Check engine oil by pulling, wiping, fully reseating, rereading, and replacing a dipstick; candidate calibrates proximity switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Long flexible-tool extraction, wiping, narrow-tube reinsertion, and procedural sequencing versus mounted rigid-part adjustment and fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Dipstick must follow the correct wipe/reseat/read sequence and finish reseated without spill or contamination; candidate requires two secured sensor registrations.
comparison.reason: Procedural memory is generic; the record does not test clearance registration or hold-while-tightening.
